claims.text: The platform's own trace gives the driver a single continuous in-geofence run of 240 seconds — first qualifying fix 2026-09-03T17:15:00, last fix 2026-09-03T17:19:00, 25 qualifying fixes — against the 300 second minimum the fee schedule sets for a LARGE_VENUE pickup. That is a 60 second shortfall, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails and the cancellation fee is not chargeable.

Where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum for the zone class, POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation fee to be refunded to the rider IN FULL, 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The fare ledger shows SGD 8.00 charged and SGD 0.00 refunded, so the full SGD 8.00 falls to be returned.

The shortfall is not an artefact of how the dwelling clock is started. Even measuring from the driver's own 'arrived' marker at 17:15:20 (the derived dwell_start_offset_sec is 20 s after the first qualifying fix), the driver had held position only about 220 seconds when he cancelled at 17:19:00 — and his own in-app message 'I have to cancel now', sent at 17:18:40, shows he had already decided to terminate before the required dwell could elapse.

The rider does not rest its case on POL-NS-04, and says so plainly: the rider track holds 11 fixes but rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0, i.e. no qualifying rider fix falls inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE, and the rider sent no locating message, so limbs (a) and (c) of that clause fail on the admissible evidence. That does not help the driver on the only question that decides this fee: POL-NS-06 refunds a dwell shortfall whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-09103-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0): no advisory covers this pickup road, so holding position was not prevented by any KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT condition, and POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable — the rider does not assert it. In any event the trace shows only one in-geofence interval (run_count = 1), so there is no second interval to sum and the 60 second shortfall cannot be cured by accumulation.

Nothing in this bundle is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08, so no discount and no escalation arises. There is no clock skew: the 17:15:20 'arrived' marker coincides with a fix and the 17:19:00 cancellation coincides with the last fix (limb (a) not engaged); the trace has 25 fixes, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0 (limb (b) not engaged); the chat_log carries exactly the 3 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, with no numbering hole (limb (c) not engaged); and the SGD 8.00 cancellation-fee line equals the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee, exactly as fee_schedule.resolution_rule prescribes (limb (d) not engaged).

The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 reads driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d only; at 1 and 120 the count is below 4 and the ratio is far below 0.08, so the check does not trip and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged either, and the evidence is clean, so POL-NS-09(a) is not engaged. The disputed SGD 8.00 should be refunded to the rider, not placed on hold.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 compensates the driver at 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here the dwell fell 60 seconds short, POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-01, and the fee is refunded in full with no compensation to the driver.

POL-NS-03 has no application on this record: the driver's trace places him 24.0 m from the pickup pin at every fix (min = max = mean = 24.0 m), well inside the 120 m arrival radius for LARGE_VENUE, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1. There is therefore no wrong-entrance case and no pin-ambiguity goodwill to compute, and the driver's own message 'At the mall ride-hail bay' confirms he was at the assigned bay. The dispute turns on dwell alone.

Any argument built on rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags (value 1) would be misplaced. POL-GEN-01 fixes rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d as the only citable rider counter for POL-NS-09(d), and that field reads 0; prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter that is context only and may never carry an adverse finding against the rider in this case.

claims.text: The driver arrived within the meaning of POL-NS-02. Every one of the 25 driver fixes in EV-GPS-09103 is a qualifying fix (qualifying_fix_count 25) and each falls inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius for the recorded pickup pin, the driver's mean distance from that pin being 24.0 m. POL-NS-01 limb (b) is therefore satisfied: this is not a never-arrived case and the arrival marker is backed by the trace itself.

The hold was continuous and stationary, not a drive-by. The trace carries 25 consecutive in-geofence fixes at a 10 second cadence from 2026-09-03T17:15:00 to 17:19:00, with no sampling gaps at all (gaps empty, max_gap_sec 0.0) and a single distinct speed reading of 0.0 km/h across the whole run. The driver did what POL-NS-01(c) asks of a driver at a large-venue bay; the only live question on the fee is the length of the hold, not the driver's good faith.

The driver's contemporaneous account is corroborated rather than contradicted. He messaged 'At the mall ride-hail bay.' at 17:15:45, and the trace independently places him 24.0 m from the recorded bay pin, stationary, for the whole window; the recorded pickup is itself labelled a mall ride-hail bay in EV-TRIP-09103 and carries venue_id VEN-PLAZA-SINGAPURA. His counterparty statement that he was at the marked bay but the rider did not appear is consistent with the telemetry and the chat log.

No false-arrival finding under POL-NS-05 is available against this driver. The clause bites only where the arrived event places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or above; at the recorded 17:15:20 arrival the driver was 24.0 m from the pin and stationary at 0.0 km/h. The waiting clock is not zeroed and no false-arrival referral arises.

Nothing in POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider. Limb (a) fails on the face of the chat log, which contains no rider message at all - the three entries are the system arrival notice and two driver messages. Limb (c) fails affirmatively rather than being undecidable: 0 of the rider's 11 fixes fall inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider presence radius, the rider's track sitting 519.4 m from the pickup pin throughout. The rider's own device record therefore places them away from the bay, and the rider-exoneration clause does not apply.

POL-NS-03 is not the governing clause and cannot be turned against the driver. It applies only where the stationary driver sits outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; this driver was inside the 120 m radius for the entire run. With registered_pickup_points at 1 there is also no pin ambiguity, so the platform-funded goodwill provision in POL-NS-03(ii) is not engaged on this record.

The SGD 8.00 charged is the correct figure under the fee_schedule resolution rule: the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00) is SGD 8.00, which is exactly the cancellation-fee line in EV-FARE-09103. The rider's complaint about 'the XL cancellation fee' identifies no overcharge and there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d).

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver and there is no basis to withhold anything from him as a farmer: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the four-termination trigger, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008, far below the 0.08 ratio. These are the only two fields POL-NS-07 reads.

The lifetime counter driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags is 2, but that is not the field POL-NS-07's check reads and it is not rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d either. POL-GEN-01 fixes which counter answers which test, and the lifetime figure is context only and may not be substituted for the trailing-window figure by either side.

I do not stretch the arithmetic that decides the fee against the driver. The qualifying in-geofence run is 240 seconds against the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, a 60 second shortfall; the trace shows a single in-geofence run, so there is no second interval for POL-NS-06 limb (i) to accumulate, and on that computation POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation. The driver's conduct on this trip was an honest hold inside the geofence, and it fell 60 seconds short of the clock - that, and not any failure to attend or to arrive, is the whole of the rider's case.

ruling.explanation: Both parties accept the key timing facts, and they decide this case. The driver did arrive and was stationary inside the large-venue pickup geofence: EV-GPS-09103 shows 25 consecutive in-geofence fixes from 17:15:00 to 17:19:00, all about 24.0 m from the pin and inside the 120 m arrival radius, so the arrival conditions in POL-NS-02 are met. But POL-NS-01 requires a continuous in-geofence hold of at least the fee-schedule minimum of 300 seconds for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the arrived marker. The first qualifying fix is at 17:15:00 and the trip was cancelled at 17:19:00, giving a dwell of 240 seconds. That is 60 seconds short, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails. The shortfall is even larger if measured from the driver's 17:15:20 arrived marker (about 220 seconds). POL-NS-06 then applies: where the effective in-geofence dwell is below the minimum for the zone class, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present or responded. The fee charged was SGD 8.00, correctly calculated as the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), but the full SGD 8.00 must be returned. No driver compensation is payable because POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-07; the driver's good faith and stationary hold do not change the dwell requirement. There is no false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii), because qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist, and no POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity payment applies, because the driver was inside the arrival radius and there was only one registered pickup point. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09103-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), but it is not needed: POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and the trace shows only one in-geofence interval, so accumulation cannot cure the shortfall. No POL-NS-08 impairment applies: there is no clock skew, no trace gap, the chat log matches trip_record.chat_message_count and has no message-numbering hole, and the SGD 8.00 fare line reconciles with the resolution rule. No POL-NS-09 escalation is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the evidence is consistent, and no anti-farming or repeat-dispute trigger is met. The rider's absence and non-response are noted but, under POL-NS-06, do not defeat the refund.

The SGD 8.00 XL cancellation fee does not stand and is refunded to the rider in full.

Why the fee fails. A no-show fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 only if, among other conditions, the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the fee-schedule minimum for the zone class - 300 seconds for a LARGE_VENUE pickup. The platform's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-09103, weight 1.0) places the driver inside the 120 m arrival radius, at 24.0 m from the recorded bay pin, stationary at 0.0 km/h, for a single continuous in-geofence run of 240 seconds (first qualifying fix 17:15:00, last fix 17:19:00, 25 qualifying fixes). That is 60 seconds short of the 300-second minimum. The trip record (EV-TRIP-09103, weight 1.0) confirms the same window: the driver marked arrival at 17:15:20 and cancelled at 17:19:00 under reason RIDER_NO_SHOW. POL-NS-01 limb (c) therefore fails, and limb (d) fails too, because termination came before the required dwell could elapse. Because the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the minimum, POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation fee to be refunded in full, 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.' The rider was charged SGD 8.00 and SGD 0.00 has been refunded (EV-FARE-09103); the whole SGD 8.00 falls to be returned.

No driver compensation. POL-NS-07 compensates the driver at 80 percent only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-06 displaces it here, so no compensation is payable. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip in any event: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the four-termination trigger) and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008 (far below 0.08), and these are the only two fields that check reads.

Points that do not change the outcome, answered together. (1) The driver did arrive and did hold honestly: the trace puts him well inside the arrival radius (POL-NS-02 satisfied), and POL-NS-05 does not bite - at the 17:15:20 arrival marker he was 24.0 m from the pin and stationary, not more than 300 m away and not travelling at 15 km/h or above - so no false-arrival finding or referral arises. The refund is owed because the hold fell 60 seconds short, not because of any misconduct. (2) POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance / pin ambiguity) has no application: the driver was inside the 120 m radius on every fix, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill is computed. (3) POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider - there is no rider locating message in the chat log and 0 of the rider's 11 fixes fall within the 150 m rider-presence radius, the rider's device sitting about 519 m from the pin - but that is immaterial, because POL-NS-06 refunds a dwell shortfall regardless of rider presence or response. (4) The SGD 8.00 figure itself is correct: under the resolution rule it is the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee, which is exactly the cancellation-fee line in the fare breakdown, so there is no fare defect and the refund is the full SGD 8.00 rather than a reduction of it.

Evidence integrity and escalation. No artifact in the bundle is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08: there is no clock skew (the 17:15:20 marker and the 17:19:00 cancellation each coincide with a trace fix), no trace defect (25 fixes, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, rider track present), no chat defect (the 3 logged messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, with no numbering hole and no gap over 5 minutes), and no fare defect. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or presence, neither party's disputes_with_counterparty_90d is above 0, the anti-farming check is not tripped, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the deciding evidence is not impaired. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09103-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and is not relied on by this ruling. No referral is produced by any clause.

Profile fields. Both sides mentioned the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags (driver 2, rider 1). POL-GEN-01 makes those context only and neither side used them as a ground of decision, so no claim turns on them and they carry no adverse finding here.

Both parties actually agree on the decisive fact, and the platform trace bears it out. EV-GPS-09103 (weight 1.0, no admissibility issues) shows a single continuous in-geofence hold by the driver of 240 seconds, running from the first qualifying fix at 17:15:00 to the last at 17:19:00, with the driver stationary 24.0 m from the recorded pickup pin (LARGE_VENUE arrival radius is 120 m). The LARGE_VENUE minimum dwell is 300 seconds, so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is not met — the hold fell 60 seconds short — and the cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01. POL-NS-06 then applies directly: an in-geofence dwell shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded.

ruling.explanation:
Both advocates agree on the decisive arithmetic, and so do I.

THE FEE CANNOT STAND. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold. Three do: EV-TRIP-09103 records an 'arrived' event at 17:15:20; EV-GPS-09103 places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at or before that time (all 25 driver fixes sit about 24 m from the pin); and the trip was terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW. Condition (c) fails. Dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (17:15:00), not from the arrived marker, and the trace holds a single continuous in-geofence run of 240 seconds (25 fixes, 17:15:00 to 17:19:00). The minimum for a LARGE_VENUE pickup is 300 seconds. That is a 60-second shortfall, and POL-NS-01(c) therefore fails.

POL-NS-06 then governs and refunds the fee IN FULL where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum, 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.' Both the rider's claims on the shortfall and its POL-NS-06 claim are ACCEPTED. The accumulation concession in POL-NS-06(i) cannot cure the shortfall: the trace shows one in-geofence interval only (run_count 1), so there is no second interval to sum, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09103-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), which makes limb (i) unavailable rather than a ground for anyone. I do not rely on that artifact.

THE DRIVER'S CLAIMS ARE ACCEPTED BUT DO NOT CHANGE THE RESULT. He did arrive inside the geofence and held position continuously at 0 km/h; no false-arrival finding is available under POL-NS-05 (at the 17:15:20 marker he was 24 m from the pin, not over 300 m and not in motion); POL-NS-03 does not apply because he was inside the 120 m arrival radius, and with registered_pickup_points at 1 there is no pin-ambiguity goodwill under POL-NS-03(ii); and the SGD 8.00 charged is the correct figure under the fee schedule - the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee - so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The driver's own advocate accepts the 60-second shortfall. His conduct was an honest hold, but the clock, not his good faith, decides the fee, and it fell 60 seconds short.

NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-06 displaces it here, so no compensation (the SGD 6.40 figure in the money block) is payable. The anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below 4, and 1/120 = 0.008, below 0.08), so nothing is withheld from him - but nothing is owed either.

NO ESCALATION. EV-GPS-09103 and EV-TRIP-09103, the artifacts carrying the deciding dwell fact, are both at weight 1.0, and neither is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d): no clock skew (the arrived marker and the 17:19:00 cancellation each fall on a fix), no trace gap (25 fixes, max_gap_sec 0.0), the chat log holds exactly the 3 messages the trip record counts with no numbering hole, and the SGD 8.00 fee line reconciles with the fee schedule. POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0), and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. No clause produces a referral: there is no false-arrival record under POL-NS-05(ii), no anti-farming instruction under POL-NS-07, and no driver-conduct or billing-integrity referral.

PROFILES. Both advocates correctly flagged rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags and driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags as context only under POL-GEN-01. Neither lifetime counter can carry an adverse finding and I have used neither.

OUTCOME. The SGD 8.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full; the SGD 0.00 refund currently on the ledger is corrected to SGD 8.00. No payment is due to the driver.
